The facts: leaf (叶) in 2012, for business, paid 300 RMB to a fake seal maker, provided seal text, privately forged company seals: for two companies: 平舆县永盛皮革有限公司 (company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal) and 利辛县汝集镇制革有限公司 (company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal). So total six seals forged. He was caught, seals seized, identified as forged. He admitted. So the crime is forging, altering, selling state organ? Actually these are company seals, not state organs. The charge is "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" is for state organs. For private company seals, the charge is "伪造、变造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章" maybe.
